Name: fsdGalleryCSS

<![CDATA[

.pictureItem, .fileItem {
    height: 150px;
    margin: 5px;
    width: 150px;
    float: left;
    border-radius: 10px;
    -webkit-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75);
    -moz-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75);
    box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75);
    border: solid 1px gray;
    padding: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
}

.pictureItemDiv {
    position: absolute;
    display: block;
}

.pictureItemActive, .fileItemActive {
    height: 150px;
    margin: 5px;
    width: 150px;
    float: left;
    border-radius: 10px;
    -webkit-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 red;
    -moz-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 red;
    box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 red;
    border: solid 1px red;
    padding: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
}

    .pictureItemActive:hover, .pictureItem:hover, .fileItemActive:hover, .fileItem:hover {
        border: solid 1px blue;
        -webkit-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 blue;
        -moz-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 blue;
        box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 blue;
    }

    .pictureItem img, .pictureItemActive img {
        border-radius: 6px;
        width: 150px;
    }

#img_gallery_manager_view {
    cursor: pointer;
}

.div_button_fsd_gallery_capture {
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 33px;
}

    .div_button_fsd_gallery_capture:hover {
        border: solid 1px yellow;
    }

#btn_fsd_gallery_item_remove {
    width: 100px !important;
    color: red !important;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-left: 120px !important;
    margin-top: 5px;
    position: absolute;
    right: 0px;
    background-color: yellow !important;
    -webkit-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 gray;
    -moz-box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 gray;
    box-shadow: 4px 3px 5px 0 gray;
    top: 0px;
}

.fileItem_ext {
    color: gray;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 49px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.fileItem_name {
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-wrap: break-word;
    font-size: 90%;
}

.fileItem_size {
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 70%;
}

.fileItem_ext_view {
    color: gray;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 100px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    s
}

.div_bottom_content {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 5px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 70%;
    width: calc(100% - 20px);
    color: #696969;
    background-color: white;
    margin: 0px 5px;
}
